aboutUsHeroSubtitle: is a collaboration-driven ecosystem for founders, entrepreneurs, and organizations who are serious about challenging the status quo — equipped with the systems, brand, and technology to back it up.
aboutUsWhyExistTitle: The current ecosystem is broken — and we're here to fix it.
aboutUsWhyExistP1: Great ideas fail every day — not because founders lack capability, but because the support around them does. Technology feels inaccessible. Domain strategy lacks direction. And meaningful collaboration is rare.
aboutUsWhyExistP2: exists to bridge these gaps with one unified, execution-first ecosystem featuring Domains, Ventures, Creators, and Technology — so founders spend their energy on growth, not setup.
aboutUsProblem1Desc: Great concepts die without the right systems to move them forward.
aboutUsProblem2Desc: Builders shouldn't need a tech team just to access powerful tools.
aboutUsProblem3Desc: A strong online presence without clear domain strategy is a missed opportunity.
aboutUsProblem4Desc: The best growth happens together. We build the space for that.
aboutUsVisionBody: To create a disruption-driven ecosystem where businesses don't just compete — they redefine industries. A world where every ambitious founder has what they need to build something truly different.
aboutUsMissionBody: To equip entrepreneurs with everything needed to move from idea to scale — fast, confidently, and sustainably.
aboutUsPillarsSubtitle: Most companies offer services. Some offer tools. We deliver outcomes — by combining all four growth drivers into one unified platform.
aboutUsPillarVentureBody: Ideas are plentiful. Execution is rare. Venture is our startup studio and co-creation arm — where we build alongside founders from the ground up. We provide ready-to-deploy infrastructure, scalable business models, and hands-on support from concept to market launch.
aboutUsPillarDomainsBody: In today's digital market, a strong domain is your foundation. Our Domains pillar helps you register, manage, and leverage domains to build a distinct, market-ready presence — while CoBrother powers the engine behind the scenes. You leverage our ecosystem. You own your domain — completely.
aboutUsPillarCreatorsSub: A network that challenges the norm
aboutUsPillarCreatorsBody: Growth doesn't come from comfort zones. Creators is our network of builders, innovators, and forward-thinkers. They collaborate, share real opportunities, and solve genuine problems together. This isn't just a network — it's a movement.
aboutUsPillarTechBody: Technology should be an advantage, not a barrier. We bring ready-to-use, scalable tech directly to businesses — eliminating the need to build from scratch. Pre-built systems, plug-and-play infrastructure, and customizable solutions. You focus on growth. We handle the foundation.
aboutUsDiff1Title: We deliver outcomes, not just services
aboutUsDiff1Desc: Other companies hand you tools and walk away. We stay in — combining venture building, domains, and tech into one unified outcome.
aboutUsDiff2Desc: Our execution-first approach means founders launch faster, iterate sooner, and grow without getting stuck in setup mode.
aboutUsDiff3Desc: Your brand, your IP, your business. We power the infrastructure — you keep complete ownership and control.
aboutUsDiff4Desc: Designed for the grassroots entrepreneur, the first-time founder, and the scaling startup — not just the well-funded few.
aboutUsDiff5Desc: The Creators network isn't a side feature. It's a core growth driver — real connections, real opportunities.
aboutUsDiff6Desc: Done-For-Me tech that works from day one. No lengthy setup, no steep learning curve — just results.
aboutUsWhoForTitle: If you're building something meaningful, you belong here.
aboutUsWhoForBody: is built for people who are serious about execution — whether you're just starting out or ready to scale what you've already built.
aboutUsAudience1Desc: With a clear vision and the drive to execute it.
aboutUsAudience2Desc: Ready to take their first serious step forward.
aboutUsAudience3Desc: Looking to grow smarter with better tools and systems.
aboutUsAudience4Desc: Who want to turn their craft into a scalable brand.
aboutUsAudience5Desc: That need a technology partner, not just a vendor.
aboutUsBigPictureP1: Our goal is to produce a generation of creators — businesses and individuals who don't just follow markets, but reshape them. People who build with purpose, move with speed, and grow without artificial limits.
aboutUsBigPictureP2: That's the bigger vision behind every product, every community, and every line of code we write.

privacyPageIntro: CoBrother ('we', 'our', 'us') values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our platform, website, and services.
privacySection1Body1: This Privacy Policy applies to all users of CoBrother, including visitors, registered users, and customers, regardless of location.
privacySection1Body2: It covers personal data collected when you create an account, use our platform or services, and contact or interact with us.
privacySection2Item1: Information you provide: full name, email address, phone number, profile details, business or listing information, and payment details (if applicable).
privacySection2Item2: Automatically collected data: IP address, device information, browser type, and usage behavior such as pages visited and clicks.
privacySection2Item3: Data from third parties: social media platforms (if login is integrated), analytics providers, and public sources.
privacySection2Item4: Data we generate: insights created using analytics and AI to improve services and personalize user experience.
privacySection3Item3: Enable listings, connections, and other platform features.
privacySection3Item4: Process transactions and provide customer support.
privacySection3Item6: Send updates, notifications, and marketing communications.
privacySection3Item7: Analyze performance and improve user experience.
privacySection4Body: We process your data based on your consent, contractual necessity, legal obligations, and legitimate business interests.
privacySection5Body1: We may share your data with service providers (hosting, payment, analytics), business partners (only when required for services), and legal authorities (if required by law).
privacySection5Body2: We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacySection6Body1: We use cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies to operate the platform, remember your preferences, and—only with your consent—to measure site usage (for example, Google Analytics) and support advertising (for example, Meta Pixel).
privacySection6Body2: When you first visit our website, a cookie banner lets you accept all cookies, reject non-essential cookies, or manage preferences by category. Your choices are stored in a cookie on your device so we can honor them on future visits. You can update your preferences at any time using the "Cookie preferences" link in the site footer.
privacySection6Body3: Non-essential tracking scripts do not load until you opt in. You may also control cookies through your browser settings.
privacySection7Body: We store your data securely using trusted infrastructure providers and implement encryption, access controls, secure servers, and regular monitoring.
privacySection8Body: We retain personal data as long as your account is active, as required by law, or for legitimate business purposes. When no longer needed, data is deleted or anonymized.
privacySection9Body: You have the right to access your data, correct inaccurate data, delete your data, request data portability, and control marketing preferences.
privacySection10Body: CoBrother does not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18.
privacySection11Body: Your data may be processed in different countries. We ensure compliance with applicable data protection laws.
privacySection12Body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be posted on this page.
